description: typical load profiles is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Electricity demand > JASM load profiles for Switzerland", published or maintained by data.sccer-jasm.ch (publisher inferred from the link). The Joint Activity on Scenario Modeling (JASM) in Switzerland has published typical load profiles for a variety of different loads along with other input data of their modeling activities. Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Electricity demand" lists it under "JASM load profiles for Switzerland". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity demand inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
